recorded_manual_work: Check bookings individually and copy mandatory timesheet instructions into missing shifts.
proposed_improvement: Apply an approved instruction template and flag missing instructions; preview affected future shifts.

recorded_manual_work: Rewrite instructions using separate AI tools, adjust formatting, keep before/after copies and mark edits manually.

recorded_manual_work: Look up addresses and travel distance, compare with saved values, and manually change kilometres and time. Previous booking values may remain after roster changes.

recorded_manual_work: Move recurring shifts from a departing worker to a replacement, check travel and remember to inform the participant. Staff demonstrate a future-shift update option.

recorded_manual_work: Search prospect and active-client lists to locate a consultation; a record was moved to active earlier than intended.

recorded_manual_work: Administrator proposes refreshing email every 30 minutes for bookings and sending periodic updates. This is a proposed routine, not measured actual frequency.

proposed_improvement: Display unambiguous dates and schedule follow-up reminders; distinguish plan dates from agreement dates.

proposed_improvement: Track cancellation as a multi-step task with verified booking update, notifications and unresolved-step alerts.

proposed_improvement: Ask whether travel occurred and propose the appropriate charge changes before cancelling, under approved business rules.

recorded_manual_work: Remember notes about hour adjustments, leave and back pay while preparing pay.

recorded_manual_work: Review and correct mismatches between the actual service and the assigned support category, including travel items.
proposed_improvement: Validate service/category/travel mappings before export and present exceptions to the bookkeeper.

recorded_manual_work: Discuss invoice chasing, concern over returned invoices delaying cash for payroll, and plan-manager changes that are not always communicated.
